annotations.title: Group a campaign into review sections

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Puts the campaign's not-yet-sectioned pieces into review sections (groupBy: week, channel_set, variant_group, episode or phase; default the brand's setting). Existing sections and decisions are kept.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/campaigns/{id}/review.)
name: group_campaign_review
title: Group a campaign into review sections
